high_level_description: This image is a screenshot of an Instagram post from the user "leclassyvie." The post features a close-up photograph of a glass of red wine with a lit cigar resting on top of it. The glass is placed on a white marble countertop, which adds a luxurious and elegant touch to the scene. The background shows part of a modern interior, including a mirror reflecting some decorative items such as a small elephant statue and a vase with flowers. The lighting is soft and warm, contributing to a sophisticated and relaxed atmosphere.
